verdicts.reason: A: the sage circle has come apart from the can and now sits behind the body copy at the far left, so the text collides with the shape and the product loses its backdrop. The body copy is also jammed against the left edge, sits first in the reading order before the headline, and the badges have about the same visual weight as the CTA. B fixes the main problem by keeping the circle behind the can. It still shares A's flaws: tiny body copy with almost no left margin, a jumbled order (copy, then product, then headline, then brand), the SOLSTICE wordmark demoted to a spot under the headline, and a crowded row where the CTA and both badges compete.
